items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I'm going to say this to my great old friend Barbara Reid.

ctx.x: I don't think I'll ever play no more. Your voice is good and strong, as strong as ever, I think.

Yeah, but I feel bad at all times. I'm going to say this to my great old friend Barbara Reid. Hello, Barbara. I sure love to live to see you again, babe. From the good old days at the Victory Club. When you and Bill and the gang would come to see, would knock me out. Would do me all the good. You people was a great inspiration to me. And I always think of you, Barbara. I haven't seen you since the good old days up in the... Where I played for the Jazz Club. The Roosevelt Hotel. So... Be sweet. Hope to see you…
Hello, Barbara. I wish you were here with us. And we often talk about you.
